target: LSP-hardening: run an LSP in-container so ASTEngine navigation uses real reference resolution instead of silently falling back to regex grep.
invariants: Every event stream must have >=1 publisher and >=1 consumer.
Fail-closed on protection/identity; fail-open on advisory/telemetry.
Deploy runtime proof required; no build-then-strand.

pr.title: feat(dopecode): LSP-backed navigation
pr.body: ASTEngine references silently degrade to regex grep without LSP. Harden LSP presence + usage.

steps.task: Ensure LSP is present + used; remove silent grep-fallback for references (or make it explicit/degraded).
validation: find_references uses LSP when available; grep-fallback is explicit + flagged degraded, not silent; unit-tested.
